trajectory_summary: This call never becomes a standard setter call — the customer is mid-crisis with an existing $32k Freedom Forever contract and panels already on his roof, and the rep never formally runs orphaned_flow to diagnose it. Energy stayed high throughout from the customer's side but the rep never converted that energy into a concrete next step; it ends on a vague 'call me in a month.'
outcome_dispute: v1 tag unknown/unclear; this should not be scored as a normal booked/no_appointment setter call — it's closer to a disqualified-pending-contract-release scenario the rep half-recognized but never formally processed via orphaned_flow.

observed_outcome.quote: give me about a month or so, I guess. I gotta try and get out of this contract.
observed_outcome.reasoning: No day/time was set; customer deferred with a vague month-out timeline and rep agreed to just keep notes, which is a soft callback with no locked date.

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: Bill amount was captured ("between 2 and 300 a month" and later $150-250/$300-400) but never flipped into alignment-against-the-utility; rep instead got confused about whether customer even had a bill to flip, and the flip line should have gone at 04:47 ('we would actually lower that') but that stayed transactional, not emotional.

bill_document_audit.reasoning: The rep asked for the monthly bill amount but did not request the actual utility bill or a photo/email of it.

interest_reason_audit.reasoning: The rep did not ask why the customer was interested in solar; the customer volunteered cost-related concerns but that was not prompted by an interest question.

primary_coaching_focus.topic: Orphaned flow never run on a clear existing-system customer
primary_coaching_focus.quote: I already got the panels up there. They already put the panels up there.
primary_coaching_focus.why: The customer handed the rep a textbook existing-solar scenario three times; running orphaned_flow (own/lease, company, working status) would have produced a real qualification instead of a confused freeform conversation.

key_moments.quote: I already got the panels up there. They already put the panels up there. They did that in one day. I know that don't cost no $32,000.
key_moments.stewart_read: This is the clearest orphaned_flow trigger in the call — existing system, existing loan, customer already suspicious of the deal — and the rep does not run the orphaned_flow question set.
